test_title: PYST 9: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements: **Some sofas are teapots. All teapots are printers. Some printers are vases.

**Conclusion I:** Some teapots are sofas.

**Conclusion II: **Some vases are printers.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ec19f73cd30e2d89bf9923a5ec739313a8d3e57e5da244a51416418b3b0cbfa.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some teapots are sofas → Follow (As some sofas are teapots.. So, as some part of sofas is common with teapots therefore it is definitely true)

II. Some vases are printers → Follow (As some printers are vases. So, as some part of printers is common with vases therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".
